Mohammad Aamir
--Applicant
 Versus
Narcotics Control Bureau
--Respondent
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned counsel with 
Mr. Shubham Bhardwaj, learned counsel for 
the applicant. 
2. Mr. Shobhit Saharia, learned counsel 
for the NCB/respondent.
3. Though applicant was granted bail by 
the Coordinate Bench on 28.04.2026 but infact 
there were more added section in which the 
applicant was charge sheeted i.e. Section 27-
A of N.D.P.S. Act and the charges were 
framed by the trial court on 19.01.2026 but 
this fact has not been apprised to the 
Coordinate Bench when the Coordinate 
Bench grant him bail for the offence 
punishable under Section 8/21(b) & 29 of 
N.D.P.S. Act. Due to addition of Section 27-A 
of the N.D.P.S. Act, the applicant moved
separate bail application before the Session 
Court and the same is rejected and then he 
moved this bail application. 
4. Mr. Shobhit Saharia, learned counsel 
for the NCB pointed out that since now 
Section 27-A of N.D.P.S. Act is added and the 
charge has also been framed against the 
applicant for Section 27-A of N.D.P.S. Act, 
therefore, the rider of Section 37-A of 
N.D.P.S. Act will come into the way of the  applicant.
5. Let on the aspect of impact of Section 
37-A of N.D.P.S. Act, learned counsel for the 
applicant may address to this Court, on the 
next date by placing on record the balance 
sheet or to get the certificate from the 
Charted Accountant about his worth. 
6. List on 22.09.2026. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 11.09.2026
